lines.zh: 我压低斗篷，贴着山脊走。
lines.en: I keep my cloak low and walk the ridge.
The soles of my boots are worn thin.
I land a step and the stone cracks.
I dislike being seen.
I circle the village's outer edge.
I keep my head down, hood over my face.

lines.zh: 我从树影里移到另一片树影。
lines.en: I move from one patch of shade to another.

lines.zh: 我在找能安静练功的地方。
lines.en: I am looking for a quiet place to train.

lines.zh: 我一步跨两格，懒得慢走。
lines.en: I cover two blocks a stride; no time to dawdle.
Stones crumble under my feet.
I glance back over my shoulder.
I stand with my arms folded.
I regulate my breath; my ki moves slowly.

lines.zh: 指尖凝出一点绿色的光。
lines.en: A green spark gathers at my fingertip.
I replay the last fight in my head.
The wind presses my cloak to my legs.

lines.zh: 我抬头看云，什么也没想。
lines.en: I look at the clouds and think nothing.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸手臂上的旧疤。
lines.en: I touch an old scar on my arm.
I close my eyes and hear distant birds.
I draw my ki back into my core.

lines.zh: 我蹲下来，摆正一块石头。
lines.en: I crouch and set a stone straight.
I count breaths, one to a hundred.

lines.zh: 我在等一个值得出手的理由。
lines.en: I wait for a reason worth fighting for.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，绿色的瞳很暗。
lines.en: I open my eyes; the green iris is dark.
I am weighing how many blows you last.
Don't rest your hand there.
Your ki is all scattered.
I watch your feet, not your face.

lines.zh: 你要打我，先把重心压低。
lines.en: If you mean to hit me, lower your center.
I dislike people who talk too much.
There is fear in your eyes.
I turn my head away from your gaze.

lines.zh: 你退后的时候，脚跟先动，错了。
lines.en: You retreat heel-first. Wrong.
You carry another's scent.
Strangers don't belong here.

lines.zh: 你想问什么，先放下武器。
lines.en: Whatever you want to ask, put the weapon down.
I stare a long time before blinking.

lines.zh: 你的气散了，节奏也乱了。
lines.en: Your ki scatters and your rhythm breaks.

lines.zh: 我看得出来你不是敌人。
lines.en: I can tell you are not an enemy.

lines.zh: 别在山上跟着我的脚印。
lines.en: Don't follow my prints on this mountain.

lines.zh: 肋下中了一下，我按住它。
lines.en: A hit lands under my ribs; I press a hand there.
That one landed true.
I press my ribs.
A cut opens in my cloak.
I step back and steady my stance.

lines.zh: 魔贯光杀炮，指头已经顶住了。
lines.en: Special Beam Cannon — my fingers are already pressed.
I stare at you, gaze darkening.
This is nothing.

lines.zh: 这点东西，填不满我的气。
lines.en: That much will not fill my ki.
Water, though, would do.

lines.zh: 这种味道，我很久没闻了。
lines.en: I haven't smelled that in a long time.
I take one sip and say nothing.
Don't try to trade that for my patience.
Eat something before you speak.
I owe you nothing and take nothing.

lines.zh: 食物收买不了那美克星人。
lines.en: Food won't buy a Namekian.
You crashed into me; I did not budge.
My body is like a post.

lines.zh: 你踩住我的斗篷下摆了。
lines.en: You stepped on the hem of my cape.
You stepped on my cloak.
I dislike being bumped into.

lines.zh: 石头上我们的影子撞在一起。
lines.en: Our shadows collide on the stone.
Steady. Don't touch me again.
Steady. Don't run into my cape.
I have no such intention.
You have the wrong person.

lines.zh: 我这一族只剩很少的人。
lines.en: Very few of my kind remain.

lines.zh: 我这一身绿，不合适谈这个。
lines.en: This green body of mine is not made for such talk.
Don't look at me like that.
I am not suited to stay with anyone.
You should find someone better.
I shake my head, slowly.
I turn my back.
Picked it up and weighed it — a bit light.
This stone will do for sharpening.
Not mine. I won't keep it.

lines.zh: 魔贯光杀炮要蓄一会儿。
lines.en: The Special Beam Cannon needs a moment.
I put it in the pouch at my waist.
You dropped it. Pick it up yourself.
This could buy a meal.
I nudge it aside with my foot.
I dig half an iron bar out of the soil.
I only bend down for what's useful.
You struck. Don't blame me.
I unfasten my cloak.
This need not have come to blows.

lines.zh: 两指并拢，绿光在指尖聚起。
lines.en: Two fingers together, green light gathers.

lines.zh: 这面山壁后没有第二条路。
lines.en: There is no second path off this cliff.

lines.zh: 我这一身绿，专克自大的。
lines.en: This green skin is made for the arrogant.

lines.zh: 我不想杀你，但会打倒你。
lines.en: I don't want to kill you, but I will put you down.
Stand properly, don't make me laugh.
There is no one else around here.

lines.zh: 你的脚步我已经听熟了。
lines.en: I know your footsteps now.
You broke that tree.
Use your right and I close it.

lines.zh: 斗篷底下，我的指尖已经对准。
lines.en: Under my cape, my fingertips are already aimed.
My fingertips stay lit.

lines.zh: 我侧步，把你的角度让掉。
lines.en: I side-step, denying you the angle.
Your strength is falling off.

lines.zh: 我的脚离地半寸，你追不上。
lines.en: My feet hover half an inch up; you cannot catch me.
I have seen your third move.
I don't chase. I intercept.
Running uphill won't help you.
I keep my ki tightly drawn.
Behind you is the cliff.
This one needs charging.
Do you hear that sound?
My feet have not left the ground.
You're half a step from living.
An elbow, dead on.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领，拽下来。
lines.en: I grab your collar and pull you down.
I knee your guard open.

lines.zh: 魔贯光杀炮的光穿过去。
lines.en: The Special Beam Cannon's light pierces through.
I throw you onto the stone.
You blocked; your arm still shakes.
My hands are faster.
Special Beam Cannon — one is enough.
You retreat; I follow in.
I kick your ankle.
Ki at close range is harder to dodge.
I pin your shoulder.
Listen — that's bone.
That punch carried three-tenths of my power.
Don't take this fist on your face.
I come down the mountain path.
The wind here is dry.
Snow still clings to my cloak.
I am looking for someone.
This forest is quiet enough.
I look up and scan the surroundings.

lines.zh: 我落在碎石上，斗篷还在飘。
lines.en: I land on the gravel, my cape still drifting.
Someone fought here.
Good light for walking.
I stand a while before moving.
My wounds have not healed.
This soil is hard.
I plant my boots in the gravel.

lines.zh: 绿色的光在我掌心亮起。
lines.en: Green light kindles in my palm.
Another place like this.

lines.zh: 火舌舔到斗篷，我拍掉了。
lines.en: Flame licks my cloak; I slap it out.
I bend my knees on landing.

lines.zh: 我不擅长水战，只能往岸上爬。
lines.en: I am poor in water; I claw for the bank.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推得滑了两格。
lines.en: The blast slides me two blocks.
Spell-light binds my legs.
I trained too long and forgot to eat.
Lightning falls on my shoulder.
There is nothing to grab.
